rationale: The candidate directly and correctly explains the required operation: call `cmd.MarkFlagsMutuallyExclusive("flag-a", "flag-b")` after defining the flags. This is fully supported by the preserved `flag_groups.go:62-77`, which declares `func (c *Command) MarkFlagsMutuallyExclusive(flagNames ...string)`, looks up each name via `c.Flags().Lookup(v)`, panics when a named flag is absent, annotates each flag with the joined group, and states that each call creates a separate group and permits membership in multiple groups. The comment at lines 62-63 also supports the claim that Cobra errors when more than one flag in the set is supplied.
